text:
maria: Hey team — Saturn Health onboarding week: they asked for a 3-part enablement (intro, integration lab, Q&A). I'm proposing Tue 10am PT / Wed 6pm CET / Thu 9am SGT for regional slots. Can folks confirm availability? cc @leo @sasha
leo: Tue 10am PT works for me. I can cover runtime best-practices and batching tips. :thumbsup:
sasha: I can do Tue morning (PT) and Thu morning (SGT) if needed. I'll prep the integration lab exercise and a short troubleshooting checklist.
jordan: Thanks — Saturn here. Wed 6pm CET is best for our EMEA engineers. Is there a Zoom link? Also we have two accounts (saturn-prod, saturn-staging) — would love a quick migration checklist.
maria: Noted. I'll split content: 30m product + 45m lab + 15m Q&A per region. Agenda draft:
```
1) 00-05m intro + goals
2) 05-35m architecture & best practices
3) 35-80m hands-on lab (staging -> prod demo)
4) 80-95m Q&A & next steps
```
Any additions?
leo: Add a 5-min quick win section (token/cost tips) — saves them money early.
sasha: Also need to ask them for prework: API key + access to staging project + 1 example prompt set.
jordan: We'll send prework by EOD Monday. Also flagging renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks — if adoption looks slow, they may raise concerns.
maria: Good flag. I'll schedule a 1:1 post-workshop success check at week+2 and add renewal health check to notes.
calendar-bot: Created event "Saturn Health Enablement - EMEA" for 2025-09-10 18:00 CET. Invitees: maria, leo, sasha, jordan. Link: https://zoom.redwood.example/meet/abc123
maria: Thanks bot. @sasha can you attach the lab repo link and a short runbook to the calendar invite? Also I'll send a short survey after the session to capture feedback and any blockers.
sasha: Will do. Repo: https://git.redwood/saturn-onboard ; runbook will be attached by tomorrow morning.
jordan: One more ask — can you include a short checklist for data privacy/KMS for our security team? They need to sign-off pre-prod.
maria: Yes — will add a "security sign-off" checkbox in the prework doc.
leo: Heads-up — I'll prepare a short demo of caching + prefix-KV examples (5 slides) and bring perf numbers.
maria: Great. If no objections I'll lock the three regional slots by EOD and send the prework template. :rocket:
jordan: Confirmed. Thank you!
leo: :thumbsup:
sasha: :white_check_mark:
maria: Closing loop — event invites sent, prework template posted in thread, follow-ups pinned. See you all in the session.
